errata_2020.verified: Image dictionary hierarchy and the Table 87 BitsPerComponent correction were inspected directly.

limitations: The full 2020 standard was not obtained; no cart, download form or account submission was attempted.
Absence of a fine-grained heading from an errata page proves neither removal nor renumbering.
Source-code comments asserting 2020 clause/table numbers are not independent standards verification.
All originals are PDF1.7; do not relabel their coverage as complete PDF2.0 conformance.

2008-samples.heading: Sample Representation
2008-samples.scope: MSB-first samples, big-endian 16-bit units, per-row byte padding, interleaved components.

2008-coordinates.heading: Image Coordinate System
2008-coordinates.scope: Top-left row order and image-to-unit-square mapping.

2008-dictionary.heading: General
2008-dictionary.scope: Image dictionary and valid component bit depths.

2008-decode.heading: Decode Arrays
2008-decode.scope: Per-component linear Decode transformation and defaults.

2008-interpolation.heading: Image Interpolation
2008-interpolation.scope: Interpolation defaults off; implementation latitude remains.

2008-indexed.heading: Indexed Colour Spaces
2008-indexed.scope: Sample indices select ordered base-space palette components.

2020-dictionary.heading: General
2020-dictionary.scope: Bit depths 1/2/4/8/16; Flate output samples agree with declared size. Other dictionary entries are outside this batch.

unpack.reason: Packed-bit, 16-bit and row-oriented image sample decoding.

indexed.reason: Indexed default decoding and palette-to-base-space conversion.

placement.reason: Decoded raster bridge, image-to-unit-square transform, graphics CTM and interpolation choice.

sampling.reason: Inverse placement mapping and nearest/bilinear raster sampling.
